english: Man... this turned into something crazy.
I mean, when you think about it,\ntraveling between worlds is a pretty wild situation.
Indeed it is...\nNormally we'd still be raising a ruckus\nat club right now...
That's what I'd like to say... but\nI can't say I'm zero percent anxious.
...I get Mii-chan's anxiety.\nHonestly, I'm scared too.\nEnough to cry if I were alone...
But I think we'll be fine,\nbecause everyone's here.
If everyone combines their strength,\nthere's nothing to fear. Nipaa☆
Indeed! No matter the hardship,\nwe'll join forces and overcome it!
But it seems big sis is too scared to move...\n*sob sob*...
H-hey, hold on! When did I ever say I was scared!
Huh, weren't you scared? I wonder?
O-of course! There's nothing\nthe great Sonozaki Mion fears!
Our club only works because\nclub president Mii-chan leads the way.
All right...\nLet's show them what our club members are made of,\neven in another world!
Ahaha...\nSis got her energy back all of a sudden...\nBut she's right.
Mii-chan has to be like that!\nI'll do my best too.
